verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a commit status API or external CI results shown as status checks on commits or pull requests. Gitea does list integrations with Drone, Woodpecker and Jenkins and offers a general API and webhooks, but these are adjacent integrations and building blocks, not a documented status-check display. Community reports of using Gitea with Drone likewise never mention status reporting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests
